tolerance.rationale: single global tolerance used for: singular-system detection, is-interior threshold (x_i > tol), zero-real-part eigenvalue test for non-hyperbolicity, and external-stability test (max_external_fitness < -tol).

tangent_projection_method: orthonormal basis of {v in R^|S| : 1^T v = 0} from scipy.linalg.null_space; J_tan = Q^T J Q; eig via scipy.linalg.eig
non_interior_policy: rows with is_interior=False have within-face Jacobian and eigenvalues NOT computed (tangent_eigvals='[]', max/min_re_eigval=NaN, has_complex_eigvals=False, within_face_class=''); external invasion fitnesses are not computed for non-interior solutions.
enumeration: every non-empty support S with |S| >= 2 is enumerated; no pruning by strict domination (Akin 1980) or any other criterion.

excluded_types.MirrorBot: (MirrorBot, MirrorBot) is non-terminating in Critch et al. 2022; MirrorBot is excluded upstream from data/payoff_matrix.csv.

(CupodBot, DupocBot).status: unresolved in Critch et al. 2022 (red cell in payoff_matrix.png); downstream verdicts that reference this cell are flagged as suspect

diagonal_undefined_policy.rule: If A[i,i] is non-finite, enumerate_pure_ess raises ValueError. The loader currently raises earlier; this is a defence-in-depth check.
diagonal_undefined_policy.reason_currently_inactive: MirrorBot excluded; no diagonal sentinel survives the loader.
